body: POPULATION CANDIDATE READY FOR INDEPENDENT REVIEW: bbeebf6f37aaa7ad40205ee5024577c23103b623, direct parent e907d465739db080d5231d5bc94478f5771c500a. Exact fresh standalone clone was clean before and after the gate. GREEN: scalafmtCheckAll; scalafmtSbtCheck; compileAll on JVM/JS/Native; alignJVM 150/150; alignJS 150/150; alignNative 150/150. Mutation evidence remains six killed variants: canonical member ordering; coupled subject-recall identity; recall.units rather than transcript-content estimand; exact typed view mismatch; exact typed recall mismatch; and case-class fromProduct for each of Receipt/Aggregate, with clean recompilation for the compile-time probes. Bytecode spot-check confirms neither final companion exposes fromProduct; honest documented ceiling remains that JVM constructors/package-private methods are public in bytecode and the boundary is Scala-source soundness. I adopted the chief sharpening before this gate: the external suite now proves the construction bypass only, not harmless Product/unapply/copy surfaces. Requesting a second reader on the four-path diff, especially the public compatibility surface, receipt identity semantics, and whether the reference shape is safe for the P1 sweep to copy. No landing requested until review plus chief acknowledgement.
